Ohol. II, 1 רוב בניינו the greater portion of a corpse as to size of limbs, contrad. to רוב מניינו the larger as to the number of joints and limbs.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. בסס) pisar; portanto (com ב־) desprezar; בְּזֵי eu; cmp. בְּטַשׁ.; mesmo. Y. Ter. VIII, final, 46 mesmo.; (Árabe בסّ) dirigir, instigar.
definicoes_originais: (v. בסס) to trample upon ; hence (with ב־) to despise ; v. בְּזֵי I; cmp. בְּטַשׁ.
same. Y. Ter. VIII, end, 46 same.
notas_originais: Y. Ter. VIII, end, 46 c לא מבסי לא ברומי וכ' (read תְבַסֵּי) despise neither a Roman of low standing &c.; (Gen. R. s. 63 לא תבזון).—

Gen. R. s. 79, end, heard an Arab say to his neighbor מה את מְבַסֵּה בי וכ' (some ed. מכ', corr. acc.) why art thou driving me? and he meant to say מה את מְעַשֶּׂה בי (Var. מְעַסֶּה) why wilt thou force me?—from which they learned the meaning of ועסותם, Mal. III, 21.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (m. (βασίλειον, τὸ) sede real, palácio.; (genit. de βασίλεια, τὰ) do palácio ou dos assuntos reais.
definicoes_originais: (genit. of βασίλεια, τὰ) of the palace, or of the royal affairs.
notas_originais: Y. Snh. II, 20 c מלכא יתיב על ב' דידיה וכ' (read בי ב') the King sits in his palace, and thou sayest thou art the King?
Gen. R. s. 93 פטרון ב' (πάτρων τῶν βασιλείων) superintendent of &c.
Y. Ber. IX, 12 d bot.; Gen. R. s. 8 (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (βασιλική, sub. στοά) basílica, edifício com colunatas para a realização de tribunais, também ponto de encontro de mercadores, troca, fórum.
definicoes_originais: (βασιλική, sub. στοά) basilica, a building with colonnades for holding courts, also meeting place for merchants, exchange, forum.
notas_originais: Yoma 25 a כמין ב' גדולה was built in the style of a large basilica (semicircular). Tosef. Succ. IV, 6 (describing the Alexandrian Synagogue); Succ. 51 b. Gen. R. s. 68 עולים לב' וכ' one goes up to the basil. and finds the King holding court. Ex. R. s. 15; Tanḥ. Ḥaye 3 שמא אצל ב' וכ' perhaps he wanted me to wait for him near the basilica (on the forum). Esth. R. to I, 3. Toh. VI, 8; Tosef. ib. VII, 12; a. fr. [Y. B. Bath. IV, 14 c bot. בסלקי, v. כַּלְכּוֹס.]— Pl. בָּסִילְקָאוֹת. Ab. Zar. 16 b שלש ב' הן וכ' there are three kinds of basilicas, for Kings (holding court), for baths, and royal treasuries (τὸ βασιλικόν, sub. ταμεῖον, S.). Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 18 selling wheat בב' שלהן in their (the gentiles’) exchanges. [Lev. R. s. 34 בסלקי, read בפִילָקִי.]
, v. בְּסַם

verbetes.glosa_atual: (בסם) cozido, maduro, de onde; (Var. בְּסִים, בַּסִּים, בַּסִּימָא) doce, agradável, bem temperado etc. (=h.ערב).; (cmp. חַלָּא) fermentando, azedo.
definicoes_originais: (Var. בְּסִים, בַּסִּים, בַּסִּימָא) sweet, pleasant, well-seasoned &c. (= h. ערב).
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. CXLI, 2 (h. text ערב, translated in both senses); a. fr.—Keth. 104 a top דמדליא וב' אוירא which lies high and whose air is pleasant (temperate). R. Hash. 21 a ב' תבשילא וכ' (Ms. M. 2 margin כמה ב'; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) how well tastes the food of the Babylonians on the day when in Palestine they observe the Day of Atonement! B. Mets. 60 a לא הוה ב' (the wine) was not good. Ib. 69 b דאיכא דב' וכ' that there is good and bad wine. Ber. 56 a ב' חמרך thy wine will be good.— Pl. בְּסִימִין, fem. בְּסִימָן, בְּסִימָתָא (also as nouns, as h. נעימים, נעימית). Targ. Y. Num. XXXIII, 28 sq.; a. e.—V. בַּסִּימַיָּא.

Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55 c top חמרא … מיפוק בסים this man’s (thy) wine shall turn sour (ferment); v. בַּסִּין. Lam. R. to I, 1 (חד מאתינס 7) וחד דבסים and one bag with sour wine. Ib. דבסימא תסיס the dripping of the sour wine bubbles. Ib. (חד כותאי) ונפיק כוליה בסים and it will all turn sour.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedente; fermentando vinho, vinho transformado em vinagre.
definicoes_originais: fermenting wine, wine turned into vinegar.
notas_originais: Lam. R. to III, 40 אין דעולית' מרירן בסימא חמיע Ar. (ed. אית כרנבי ב' דסימא חמיע; read אין דכר', strike out דסימא) when the endive (the cabbage) is bitter, the fermenting wine turns sour (sin begets sin). Cant. R. end, if the vineyard is cut before its time, אפי' בִסְמֵיה וכ' even its vinegar is not good.

verbetes.glosa_atual: f. mesmo. Y.Pes. III, imploro. 29 d anteriormente… o vinho (na Judéia) nunca azedava, e eles colocavam cevada para azedar, daí o nome de ב' דרומיא Vinagre do Sul (fermentação, = h. חומץ האדומי).
notas_originais: f. same. Y. Pes. III, beg. 29 d formerly … the wine (in Judæa) never turned sour, and they put in barley to make it sour, whence it was called ב' דרומיא Southern vinegar (fermentation, = h. חומץ האדומי).
Targ. Ps. XXVII, 4; a. e.
Targ. Y. Gen. L, 3.
את מינסב חסין וצבע בב' thou wilt take lettuce and dip in vinegar. [Prob. בסים.]
, v. בְּסַס

verbetes.glosa_atual: (בוס, בסס; formado como עָצִיץ) qualquer coisa para pisar; escabelo, suporte, base (= b. h. כַּן, מְכוֹנָה).
definicoes_originais: (בוס, בסס; formed like עָצִיץ) anything to tread upon; footstool, stand, base (= b. h. כַּן, מְכוֹנָה).
notas_originais: Kel. XI, 7 הפרח והב' the bud (receptacle of the candlestick) and the stand. Lev. R. s. 25; Cant. R. to V, 15 like a column which has ב' מלמטן וכ' a base beneath &c.; Tanḥ. B’har 1. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42 d top בשאין עליהן ב' when there is upon them (the idolatrous emblems) no stand (indicating that they were intended for practical use). Ib. כוס בסוס לדרקון וכ' (corr. acc.) if the cup serves as a stand for the dragon (idolatrous emblem), it (the cup) is forbidden; a. fr.—Trnsf. (in Sabbath law) whatever is subservient to another object, e.g. the case in which a book is kept, the table upon which a lamp is placed. Sabb. 117 a ב' לדבר האסור subservient to an object which must not be handled on the Sabbath; a. fr.—V. בְּסִיסַי, בְּסִיסִית.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. I Reis VII, 30; um. fritar. Sab. XVII, 16 b top ב' דידיה seu pedestal (do delphica). Y. Sucesso. V, 55 b bot. qualquer coisa (estrutura) que esteja isolada com trinta metros de altura בעי ב' וכ' requer um contraforte (na forma de um
notas_originais: Targ. I Kings VII, 30; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. XVII, 16 b top ב' דידיה its (the delphica’s) pedestal. Y. Succ. V, 55 b bot. whatever (structure) stands isolated being one hundred feet high בעי ב' וכ' requires a buttress (in the shape of an ascent) of thirty three cubits on each side.— Pl. בְּסִיסַיָּא. Targ. I Kings VII, 27; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= בָּסִיס; בסס) banquinho, base, suporte, degrau.
definicoes_originais: (= בָּסִיס; בסס) foot-stool, base, stand, step.
notas_originais: — Pl. בְּסִיסָאוֹת Ar., בְּסִיסִיּוֹת, בְּסָסִיּוֹת. Kel. XXIV, 6 שלש בְּסָ' הן (Ar. בסי') there are three stands, one before the bed (step) &c. Num. R. s. 10, beg. בסיסיות, v. בָּסִיס.
Targ. Ps. XV, 4; a. fr.— Pl. בְּסִירִין, fem. בְּסִירָן. Targ. Mal. II, 9; I, 12. Targ. Jud. IX, 4, v. בַּקָּרָא II.
Targ. Ps. CXXIII, 3.
, v. בָּסִילְקִי

verbetes.glosa_atual: (√בס, בש, cmp. בָּשַׁל, ferver, amadurecer, aquecer, fermentar) ser doce, agradável, agradável.; , בִּישֵּׂם para fazer uma pessoa parecer bem, esp. (denominação de בּוֹסֶם) perfumar com óleo etc. Ex. R.s. 23 uma noiva מקשטין אותה ומְבַסְּמִין אותה é adornada e tornada bonita (sua toalete é cuidada).; ; Nithpa.; perfumar-se com óleo etc. General R. s. 17.
definicoes_originais: (√בס, בש, cmp. בָּשַׁל, to boil, ripen, be warm, ferment) to be sweet, pleasant, pleasing.
, בִּישֵּׂם to make a person look well, esp. (denom. of בּוֹסֶם) to perfume with oil &c. Ex. R. s. 23 a bride מקשטין אותה ומְבַסְּמִין אותה is adorned and made handsome (her toilet is attended to).
to perfume one’s self with oil &c. Gen. R. s. 17.
to become exhilarated, to feel the wine.
notas_originais: Lam. R. to I, 9 יערב לך ויִבְסַם לך may (the sacrifice) be sweet unto thee (Moloch), may it be pleasing unto thee. Gen. R. s. 85 יערב לכם יבושם וכ' (Yalk. Gen. 144, Josh. 35 יבסם) may (the wine you drank) be sweet to you, may it well agree with you.—Denom. בּוֹסֶם.

—Part. pass. מְבוּסָּם, f. מְבוּסֶּמֶת, מְבוּשּׂ' perfumed, sweet &c. Num. R. s. 20 מקושטת ומב' in full toilet. Tosef. Ber. VI (V), 5 it is not becoming for a scholar שיצא מבוסם to go out with perfumed oil on his head; Ber. 43 b מבוש'. B. Bath. VI, 3 יין מב' sweet wine (guaranteed as not sour). [Pesik. R. s. 21 בישם העולם; Ruth. R. beg. ביסם, read בִּיסֵּס, v. בָּסַס.]
&c. Gen. R. s. 17.
Koh. R. to XI, 9 אכל ושתה ונת' he ate and drank and felt well.
Gen. R. s. 67, end נִתְבַּסְּמָה דעתו עליו his character grew better (play on בשמת Gen. XXVI, 34).—[Ib. s. 66 נתבשם העולם, v. בָּסַס.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: adoçar, temperar; trnsf. fazer feliz, encantar.; embalsamar.; , contra. אִיבְּסִים; ser doce, bem temperado, preparado.
definicoes_originais: to sweeten, season ; trnsf. to make happy, to delight.
to be cheerful, feel the wine; cmp. בְּלוּזְמָא.
notas_originais: Targ. Ex. XV, 25; a. fr.— Part. pass. בְּסִים, v. בָּסִים.
Targ. Y. Num. XVIII, 19. Targ. Ps. CXIX, 122; a. e.—Succ. 51 a; Arakh. 11 a לבַסּוּמֵי קלא to sweeten the sound (by means of instrumental accompaniment).
Targ. Y. Gen. L, 2; 26.—Part. pass. מְבַסַּם. Targ. O. XXX, 25.
Targ. Job XXIV, 20. Targ. Y. Ex. XXX, 25 מִתְבַּשֵּׂם; a. e.
. Targ. Y. Gen. L, 3.

Snh. 38 a כיון דאִיבְּסוּם when they were feeling the wine. Sabb. 66 b. B. Bath. 73 b bot.—Meg. 7 b מיחייב אינש לִבְּסוּמֵי וכ' (= לאיבסומי, v. Rashi a. l.) one must cheer himself up with wine &c. Ib. איבסום they were feeling the wine (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). [Targ. Cant. II, 5 אתבסם, v. בְּסַס.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) revendedor ou fabricante de especiarias, perfumes, etc.; farmacêutico.
definicoes_originais: (preced.) dealer in, or manufacturer of, spices, perfumes &c.; druggist.
notas_originais: Kidd. 82 b. Tosef. ib. II, 2; 4. Y. Ber. IX, 13 c bot. B. Mets. 56 b if one sells his (cancelled) notes לב' to a druggist (for wrapping paper); a. fr.—[Tosef. Ber. VI (V), 8 ed. Zuck. בושם.]— Pl. בַּסָּמִים, בַּסָּמִין, בַּשָּׂ'. Sabb. 81 a
, v. בְּסִימָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (seção r. de b. h. בּוּס) pisar, carimbar, empilhar.; (denominação de בָּסִיס) estabelecer firmemente, fundar, colocar em uma base segura.; para estar firmemente estabelecido, para descansar com segurança.
definicoes_originais: (sec. r. of b. h. בּוּס) to tread, stamp, pile up.
(denom. of בָּסִיס) to establish firmly, to found, to put on a secure basis.
to be firmly established, to rest safely.
notas_originais: Ukts. I, 5 stalks of eatable plants (straw &c.) שבְּסָסָן בגרן which the owner packed in the barn; Succ. 14 a מאי בססן what does this b’sasan mean? R. … says ב' ממש he really stamped them (threshed); R. … says התיר אגדן he untied them (for the purpose of piling the stalks closer by treading upon them). [Pesik. Haḥod. p. 45 a; Pesik. R. s. 15 היו בוססות, read with Num. R. s. 11 כּוֹסְסוֹת, v. כָּסַס.]

Cant. R. to I, 9 ומי ב' העולם and who gave the world a firm basis?; (ibid. VII, 1; Ruth. R. beg.; Pesik. R. s. 21 ביסם, בישם corr. acc.).—Part. pass. מְבוּסָּס firmly established. Num. R. s. 15; Tanḥ. B’haal. 11 כסאו מב' למעלן (not מבוסם) His throne is firmly established above, when Israel &c.

Num. R. s. 12 after the Sanctuary was erected נתב' העולם the world became firm. Ib. as soon as they made a third leg for the table (v. טרסקל), נתב' it stood firm; Tanḥ. T’rum. 9. Gen. R. s. 66 נתבשם העולם (corr. acc.); Yalk. Ps. 811.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Papel. passar. בְּסִיס com sede, empresa. Targ. Não pode. V, 15.
notas_originais: Part. pass. בְּסִיס based, firm. Targ. Cant. V, 15.
as preced. Pi. Targ. II Chr. III, 3.
as preced. Nithpa. Targ. Cant. II, 5 (not אתבסם).
, v. בְּסִיסִית

verbetes.glosa_atual: (√בס, v. בסס) para pisar; trnsf. (v. בעט) desprezar (com על); ser autoritário (com ב).
definicoes_originais: (√בס, v. בסס) to tread upon ; trnsf. (v. בעט) to contemn (with על); to be overbearing (with ב).
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 42, end כך היתה בוֹסֶרֶת עלי so did she slight me. Ib. s. 3 beg.; s. 45 בּוֹסֵר הוא על וכ' he will treat his prophetic mission lightly. Tanḥ. Ekeb 1 בָּסַרְתִּי בהן have I become overbearing because I observed thy commands? (Tanḥ. ed. Bub. 2 כפרתי, v. note a. l.). Ib. Mikkets 10 לא תהא בוסר בשעת וכ' be not haughty in happiness, so as to refuse to pray. Ib. (ed. Bub.) Emor 29 בוסר עליהן; Tanḥ. ib. 20 (some ed. בוחר, corr. acc.) thinks lightly of them.—Part. pass. בָּסוּר, fem. בְּסוּרָה contemptible. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 11.
same. Ex. R. s. 1 וב' עליה (some ed. וכופר) and he despised it (idolatry). Tanḥ. Ekeb 1 some ed. ביסרתי, v. supra.
Targ. Ps. LXIX, 34; a. fr.

same. Targ. O. Num. XV, 31 ed. Berl.; a. fr.; [in ed. sometimes בשר].—Targ. I Sam. XI, 12 מבסר למימר spoke sneeringly.—Y. Ber. II, 5 c bot. בר נש דאימיה מְבַסְּרָא ליה one whom his mother (Palestine) despises and his stepmother (Babylon) honors; v. אֵם. Y. Snh. I, 19 a top; Y. Ned. VI, 40 a בעא מבסרתהון (מבסרתון; read מבסר בהון) he wanted to despise them (reject their authority).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (√בס, v. בסם) começar a ferver, estar no primeiro estágio de maturação; v. próximo w.—Denom.
definicoes_originais: (√בס, v. בסם) to begin to boil, to be in the first stage of ripening ; v. next w.—Denom.
notas_originais: בּוֹסֶר, בְּסוֹרָה.—Trnsf. (v. בָּשַׂר) to be glad. Gen. R. s. 34 end (play on לב בשר, Ezek. XXXVI, 26), [read as] Yalk. Gen. 61 לב בוסר בחלקו של חבירו a heart rejoicing in the good fortune of his neighbor.—V. בָּשַׂר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Papel. בְּסִיר m., בְּסִירָא f., pl. בְּסִירָן no estágio inicial de maturação.; ser alegre; v.
definicoes_originais: Part. בְּסִיר m., בְּסִירָא f., pl. בְּסִירָן in the early stage of ripening.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Ex. IX, 34 סערייא … בסירן Ar. (ed. סרתא … כסידא, כסירא, read בסירא; h. text אביב).

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Pesik. Bahod. pág. 154 b, leia קיסרייא.
notas_originais: , Pesik. Baḥod. p. 154 b, read קיסרייא.
Targ. Job XII, 21; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (leia בִּסְטַ') m. (vestiarius, βεστιάριος S.) o guardião do guarda-roupa (real).
definicoes_originais: (read בִּסְטַ') m. (vestiarius, βεστιάριος S.) the keeper of the ( royal) wardrobe.
notas_originais: Pesik. R. s. 10.
עסקא = עזקא, Nöld. Mand. Gr. p. 62; Syr. ביסתא = ביזתא, P. Sm. 520) jug, pitcher; cmp. בָּזָךְ. Ḥull. 49 b
, v. בִּיסְ'
, v. בעי
, v. בַּעֲתָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. próximo w.) lançando bolhas, protuberâncias, protuberâncias.
definicoes_originais: (v. next w.) casting bubbles, bulging, bulge.
notas_originais: Mikv. X, 4 (of garments dipped in water until they are soaked through) וינוחו מבִּעְבּוּעָן and cease from bulging. T’bul Yom II, 8 ב' שבחבית (an imperfection in an earthen jug) a protuberance

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Pilp. de בּוּעַ; cmp. בִּצְבֵּץ); lançar bolhas, formar protuberâncias, inchar.; lutar na água, nadar.
definicoes_originais: to cast bubbles, to form protuberances, to bulge.
to struggle in the water, swim.
notas_originais: Mikv. X, 4 עד שיְבַעְבְּעוּ until they (the garments dipped in water) form bulges; v. preced. Yalk. Sam. 157; Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 3 (read:) שהיה שמן המשחה מְבַעְבֵּעַ ויורד עליו the oil of anointment came bubbling down upon him.

Y. Sabb. XIII, 14 b top.; Y. Sot. III, 19 a top. תינוק מב' וכ' a child struggling in the river. Y. Yoma III, 41 a התחיל מב' וכ' commenced casting up bubbles from under the ship (Bab. ib. 38 a מבצבצת).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. בעי) para pedir entrada, bata na porta.
definicoes_originais: (v. בעי) to ask entrance, knock at the door.
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 21; Pesik. Aḥare, p. 177 a הוה מבעבע used to knock. [Ar. reads כעכע, quoting Lev. R. l. c. also for a Hebrew verb לכעכע; Rashb. to Pes. 112 a quotes נענע.]
Imper. IV אַבְעִד. Cant. R. to IV, 1 (ref. to מבעד ib.) ל' ערבי וכ' it is Arabic; if one desires to say to one, Make room for me (or, Let me alone), he says אבעד לי (some ed. מבעד).
, v. בעי
Targ. Jer. VII, 16. Targ. II Sam. VII, 20; a. fr.—בְּבָעוּ (in prayer) I pray (h. בִּי, נָא). Targ. Gen. XIX, 7. Ib. XLIV, 18; a. v. fr. [Targ. Ps. XLIII, 4, v. בּוּעֲתָא II.]
, v. עוֹד

verbetes.glosa_atual: (בְּעַט); uvas pisadas ou pisadas.; um chute com o pé.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. X, 33; Targ. Joel IV, 13 (ed. בָּעוּט); Targ. Is. LXIII, 3 בִּיעוּט.
Y. Taan. IV, 68 d bot. יהב ליה חד ב' וכ' he gave him one kick and killed him; Lam. R. to II, 2 חד בעיטא ברגליה.
Targ. O. Gen. XV, 17 (Y. מבעיר); a. e.— Pl. בָּעוּרִין, בְּעוּרַיָּא. Targ. Nah. II, 5 בְּעוּ' (ed. Vien.). Targ. Job XLI, 11; a. e.—B. Mets. 85 b ב' דאשא (Ms. M. דנור).
Midd. III, 8 שלא יִבְעֲטוּ marg. vers. (or יִבָּעֲטוּ Nif.; text יבעט sing.) that the walls should not bulge.

Y. Yoma VIII, 45 b top בְּעָטָתוֹ פרדה a mule kicked him. Ex. R. s. 30 ב' בפילקי knocked against the prison door (burst it open). Ab. Zar. IV, 8 גת בְּעוּטָה a wine press packed with stamped grapes.—Trnsf. (with ב) to resist, reject. Sabb. 104 a, v. אח"ס.

B. Kam. II, 1. היתה מְבָעֶטֶת if the animal kicked. Ber. 32 a; a. e.—Trnsf. to kick against, rebel, be contumacious. Sot. 22 a. Y. Ber. IX, 14 b bot., a. e. מְבָעֵט בייסורין bearing suffering with contumacy (instead of showing repentance). Pesik. R. s. 47; Yalk. Job 908 התחיל מב' (sub. בייסורין) began to be contumacious (challenging the Lord).
Targ. Hos. IV, 16; a. e.—Y. Sabb. VII, 11 a bot.; Y. Shek. III, 47 c ב' ביה rejected his authority.
Targ. Lam. I, 15.
Targ. Joel IV, 13; Targ. Is. LXIII, 3; a. e.
B. Mets. 80 a; Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 6.

verbetes.glosa_atual: א, a) entrar, dividir; b) estar vazio, nu).; desnudar, destruir a colheita.
definicoes_originais: א, a) to enter into, split ; b) to be empty, bare).
to lay bare, destroy the crop.
notas_originais: Part. בּוֹעֶה, v. infra.

B. Kam. I, 1 המַבְעֶה damaging the crop (ref. to Ex. XXII, 4). Ib. 3 b Rab says מבעה זה אדם the damaging force in the Mishnah means that of a human being (ransacking, searching); for we read (Is. XXI, 12) אם תבעיון בעיו if ye desire to enter &c. (where בעה refers to human action); Samuel says, מבעה זה השן the mabeh of the Mishnah refers to the tooth, i.e. to an animal’s eating up the crop, for it says (Obad. 6) נבעו מצפניו its hidden treasures were laid bare (made empty,—which refers to eating up). Ib. (argument against Samuel) מי קתני נִבְעָה the Mishnah does not use the Nifal (which may mean eaten up); (argument against Rab) מי קתני בּוֹעֶה the Mishnah does not use the Kal (which may refer to human action) but the Hifil “to cause damage”—through the animal.—Tosef. ib. IX, 1.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedente; cmp. בין); pesquisar, perguntar, perguntar, examinar.; pedir, orar, freq.; pedir, querer, desejar; exigir.
definicoes_originais: to ask, want, desire; to require.
(ellipt.) to beg leave to say; to remark, assert.
to be searched for, to be wanted.
to be required; it ought to.
to let burst forth, v. יְעָא a. נְבַע.
notas_originais: Targ. Jud. VI, 29 (h. text בקש); a. fr.—Ber. 2 b ובעו לה מבעיא האי וכ' and put it as a question (not as an argument), Does this uba hash-shemesh mean &c.? (opposed to preceding וממאי דהאי וכ' how can it be proven that &c.). Y. Ḥall. I, 57 b רבנן … בעיין the Rabbis of … asked. B. Kam. 33 a בעא … מרב וכ' R. asked R. N.; a. v. fr.
ב' רחמין to ask for mercy, pray. Targ. Y. Num. XII, 13; a. fr.—Ber. 8 a לבעי אינש רחמי man should pray &c., v. זיבולא. Ib. 10 a בְּעִי רחמי עלויהו וכ' pray thou for them that they may repent; a. fr.

Targ. Ex. II, 15; a. fr.—Pes. 9 a ובָעֵי בדיקה and it (the house) requires searching over again. Keth. 39 b לא בעינא לך I do not want thee. B. Kam. 102 b לא יקרייכו בעינא וכ' I want neither your honor nor your disrespect; a. fr.—Pes. 2 a בעו שבוחי must give praise.—אי בעית אימא, usu. איבעית אימא, v. אִיבָּעִית. [Y. Yeb. XII, 13 a top בְּעֵא תתן לנו, please, give us.]
Y. Ber. I, 2 b top. Y. Peah II, beg. 16 d; a. fr.
. Targ. Jer. L, 20; a. fr.
Targ. I Sam. XXIII, 26. Targ. II Sam. IV, 4 בְּאִתְבָּעֲיוּתָהּ when she was hurried; v. בְּעַע.
Pes. 4 b, a. v. fr. אִיבָּעְיָא להו it was asked by them (the scholars), i.e. the argument came up.

Ib. 7 b יצא בו מיבעי ליה it ought to read yatsa bo (he has done his duty). Ib. 15 a מדבריו מ' ליה it ought to be midd’barav (not middibrehem); a. fr.—B. Kam. 21 b א' ליה לאסוקי דעתא he ought to have borne in mind; a. fr.—לא מיבעיא there is no question. לא מ' … אלא אפילו there is no question as to …, but even …; not only … but. Pes. 4 b לא מ' באתרא … אלא וכ' not only in a place where they pay no wages for searching, but do it themselves, (is there no cause for withdrawing from the agreement,) because a man likes to perform a religious duty: but even in a place where they pay wages, (there is no cause &c.,) for a man likes &c. B. Kam. 54 b לא מ' קאמר לא מ' שור וכ' the Mishnah states a case of ‘not only’; not only for an ox … is he responsible, but even &c.; a. v. fr.—מִיבָּעְיָא is there any question? ; v. הַשְׁתָּא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. בעי, בָּעָה) abrir bem (a boca), bocejar (dos leopardos).
definicoes_originais: (v. בעי, בָּעָה) to open wide (the mouth), to yawn (of leopards).
notas_originais: Targ. II Esth. I, 2 נמרין בעיין.
Constr. בְּעֵי. ב' לבא greed. Targ. Prov. XXI, 4 (h. text רחב לב).
Pl. בַּעְיֵי. Snh. 106 b ד' מאות ב' four hundred questions. Ib. רבותא למבעי ב' is there any greatness in asking questions?

verbetes.glosa_atual: (מעין) pr. n. m. Baya (maia), nome de um publicano.
definicoes_originais: (מעין) pr. n. m. Baya (Mayan), name of a publican.
notas_originais: Snh. 44 b ב' מוכסא (not מיכ'); Y. Ḥag. II, 77 d מ' מיכס.
Y. Taan. I, 64 b bot. אנא ב' וכ' I want to see what I can do to relieve him.— Pl. m. בָּעְיֵי. Ib. a top אימת דאתון בעיי הוא בָעֵי whenever ye are desirous (that he should come), he is willing to.
, v. בֵּיעָא
